title: Auditory and Visual Rhythm Omission EEG
description: EEG recordings from 18 participants who separately listened to auditory rhythms and watched visual flashing rhythms. The stimulus trains contained occasional omissions, which allowed predictive neural activity to be separated from sensory-evoked activity. The dataset supports study of the predictive mechanisms of rhythm perception. Code for preprocessing, time-frequency computation, frequency band extraction and statistics is provided.
methods_description: Participants were presented with auditory rhythms and visual flashing rhythms in separate sessions. Stimulus trains contained occasional omissions. Data were preprocessed and analyzed with time/frequency computation and frequency band extraction, and clusters were formed with the EEGLAB Study function.
